Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol and exact release packaging. The Linux installer adds six-stage terminal feedback, TTY download progress and bounded active/running process checks; startup does not prove PSP sync, core or proxy readiness. Remote upgrades require Linux/systemd, the upgrade helper, and unchanged state schema 9. Docker uses container-managed updates. Docker and Windows end-to-end installation has not been verified.
Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, pn management workflow, Docker remote upgrades and exact release packaging. Manual packages cover Linux, macOS and Windows on amd64 and arm64.

Reviewed PSP v4 agent protocol, exact release packaging and managed Docker upgrades. The public Linux installer defaults to Stable, supports explicit Beta and install-only modes, and can install from an already verified offline release package. Container startup and Agent logs include timestamps and actionable credential/data mount diagnostics.
